comment: Google Play platform requirements that are pure data and change on a published schedule. Agentship warns when a project no longer meets the highest requirement whose effectiveFrom date has passed. This table must be revised every release: an entry is only added once Google has announced the level and its date, never extrapolated.
notes: Existing apps that are not updated keep working; the requirement applies when submitting a new app or an update.
Wear OS, Android TV and Automotive follow their own schedules, which this table does not cover.
